aboutText: ABS Auto Brunswick has been providing top-quality automotive services in Brunswick West for many years. Our team of skilled mechanics specialises in car servicing, brake repair, and suspension work. With a 4.2-star Google rating from over 150 reviews, we pride ourselves on honest, efficient service that keeps our customers coming back.
servicesText: We offer a wide range of automotive services including logbook servicing, brake repairs, suspension work, and general maintenance. Our team uses the latest diagnostic tools to ensure accurate and efficient service for all makes and models.
